title: CI/CD Integration

body.text: pipelines: GitHub Actions, automated tests, build, and deploy
— and when CI goes red, send it the log to analyze the cause and get it back to green.

example: "Create GitHub Actions: run lint + tests on every PR, build when merged to main, auto-deploy to staging"

title: Fix broken CI with AI

body.text: A red CI is a great task:
paste the error log from the pipeline and have it find the root cause
— often it's a dependency version mismatch, a flaky test, or a different env, which the AI can diagnose from the log very quickly.

example: "CI fails at the 'npm test' step on Node 20 but passes locally. Here's the log: ... find the cause and fix it"

question: CI is red but local passes — what's the usual cause?
